'''RamapoCon II No Such Thing As Luck''' was a Star Wars CCG no such thing as luck held in student center, Ramapo College, New Jersey on 6 May 2000. [[Bob Caton]] won it. It is known from Scott Lingrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d741">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-reportd741/ ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-report], DeckTech (Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell, 13 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-reportd741/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[RamapoCon II]].

* '''Date:''' 6 May 2000
* '''Site:''' student center, Ramapo College, New Jersey
* '''Format:''' [[No Such Thing As Luck]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Bob Caton]]
